parts.text: On Saturday morning, Tom and his sister Mia were playing football in the park. After the game, they sat down under a tree to drink some water. Suddenly, they heard a small noise behind the tree. It was a tiny brown puppy. The puppy was hungry and very thirsty. Tom gave it some of his water and Mia gave it a piece of her sandwich. The puppy had a red collar but there was no phone number on it. "We can’t leave it here," said Mia. "Let’s take it home and ask Mum what to do." They walked home carefully. Mum was in the kitchen. When she saw the puppy, she smiled. "It’s the same puppy that Mrs Green was looking for yesterday," she said. Tom and Mia went to Mrs Green’s house. Mrs Green was very happy and gave the children some chocolate cake. The puppy’s name was Biscuit.
